| **Pros** | **Cons** |
|-----------|----------|
| **Flexibility & Autonomy** – Employees can often set their own schedules, leading to better work-life balance and increased job satisfaction. | **Isolation & Loneliness** – Lack of in-person interaction can lead to feelings of disconnection from colleagues and the company culture. |
| **No Commute** – Saves time and money, reduces stress, and lowers environmental impact. | **Blurred Boundaries** – It can be harder to “switch off” from work, leading to longer hours and potential burnout. |
| **Increased Productivity** – Many workers experience fewer office distractions and can create a personalized, focused work environment. | **Communication Challenges** – Reliance on digital tools can cause misunderstandings, delays, and a loss of spontaneous collaboration. |
